title: Keep rehearsal sampling asynchronous and distinguish runner stalls
changes: Job, queue and final timing queries await asynchronous spawn with unchanged arguments, read-only PGOPTIONS, 30 s timeout and refusal words.
Polls and health samples retain wall timestamps and performance.now start/duration measurements.
Each capture callback and final partial window records 20 ms monitorEventLoopDelay max/p99 in process.runnerLoop.
A 20 ms heartbeat locates stalls over 1000 ms; save-time attribution marks overlapping reads runnerBlocked and counts slow polls/health separately.
decisions: Slow-read summaries use a documented threshold strictly greater than 1000 ms; runnerBlocked is overlap evidence, not proof of server latency.
Attribution is recomputed on every save so later loop captures can mark previously completed reads.
Empty histograms stay null; final monitor cleanup is idempotent.

inputs.good: Existing mini-kit NYC GeoJSON and Tweed GPKG; both sizes and SHA-256 verified by existing tests.
inputs.difficult: Existing real-file manifests with deliberately mismatched size/hash metadata; deferred queries, failures and clock changes injected without Docker.

platformCheck: No scripts/test-platform suite exists or is named by the rehearsal README; timing.mjs is checked through the rehearsal suite.
gaps: No live rehearsal authorized; the historical 29.6 s and 30.2 s readings are not reclassified by this change.
safety: No product changes, runtime access, Docker invocation, provider calls or C: scratch files. No contract pins regenerated.
